# Liffio

> Liffio is an Instagram DM automation platform. It sends automatic direct messages via Instagram's official API when users trigger events: commenting on a post, replying to a story, or sending a DM.

## What Liffio does

Liffio connects to Instagram via official OAuth, with no passwords stored. After authorization, you set up automation rules called "flows." Each flow watches for a specific trigger (a comment keyword or a story reply) and sends a personalized DM.

## Automation types

- Comment-to-DM: someone comments a keyword on a post or Reel → they receive a DM automatically
- Story reply automation: someone replies to or mentions a story → they receive a DM
- DM reply automation: someone sends a DM keyword → they receive a reply
- Ask Follow (follow gate): user must follow before receiving a promised resource
- Follow-up sequences: scheduled follow-up messages within an active conversation
- Collect Data: capture email addresses shared in DM conversations and store them as leads

## Pricing (USD, billed monthly)

- Free: $0/month: 3 automation workflows, comment keyword triggers, bio link page, basic analytics
- Starter: $9/month ($7.50/month billed annually): all automation types, unlimited templates, post scheduler, short links, lead capture
- Growth (coming soon, announced but not yet available for purchase): $29/month ($24.17/month billed annually). Everything in Starter plus post, video and profile analytics, caption and schedule templates, bulk upload, 5 seats
- Business: $59/month ($49.17/month billed annually): everything in Starter plus conversion analytics, team members (15 seats), account-level insights, follow-up sequences
- Agency: $549/month ($457.50/month billed annually): 20 workspaces, each a complete Business workspace, on one subscription with one invoice and one renewal date, plus a dedicated account manager, affiliate program management and SLA-backed priority support

Annual billing charges 10 months instead of 12, so two months are free.

US dollar prices are billed as an export. No Indian GST applies. Prices shown in rupees include GST, so the amount shown is the amount charged, and a GST tax invoice is issued for every payment.

India pricing available via Razorpay in INR, incl. GST: Free ₹0, Starter ₹499, Growth ₹1,499 (coming soon), Business ₹2,499, Agency ₹22,999 per month. Every plan connects one Instagram account per workspace (Agency includes 20 workspaces). Every paid plan includes unlimited automated DMs.

## Key facts

- Founded: 2026
- Team: 5 co-founders: Shivam (CEO), Om (CTO), Vishal (CMO), Shlok (CFO), Pratham (CRO)
- Location: India
- Instagram connection: official Instagram API via Meta's OAuth consent flow (no password required, no scraping)
- Send delays: 10 to 60 seconds per automation (configurable)
- Data: GDPR-compliant, contact data exportable and deletable from dashboard
- Payment: Razorpay (USD global and INR India)
- Competing tools: ManyChat, SendDM, Chatfuel, ReplyRush, LinkDM, SuperProfile, InstaChamp, Zorcha
